title: Fleet Controls Console: Scaling Widgets, Throughput Insights, and Audit Trail
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a unified Fleet Controls section to the Redwood Console for Dedicated capacity customers. The UI will surface three primary capabilities: scaling controls (pool min/max nodes, target throughput in tokens/s or device-equivalents, manual actions like scale up/down and drain), throughput dashboards (live and historical charts for provisioned capacity, effective token throughput, queue length, per-model latency p50/p95, utilization, and autoscaler decisions) and a change history/audit trail (immutable timeline with actor, timestamp, diffs, optional reason and rollback). Filtering by model, region, and tenant is required. Out of scope: provider autoscaling heuristics, billing integration, and RBAC fine-grained controls.
acceptance_criteria: Fleet Controls is reachable from Dedicated -> Fleet in the Console navigation
Operators can set and persist pool min/max size and target throughput; saving triggers autoscaler hooks
Operators can create, name, and save autoscaling policies (thresholds: GPU utilization, request queue length, scheduled windows)
Throughput dashboard shows live metrics (last 5 minutes) and selectable historical ranges (1h, 24h, 7d) and supports CSV export
Audit trail lists configuration changes with actor, timestamp and a diff view; rollback action restores a prior config
Design passes accessibility review and console unit/e2e tests cover policy creation, rollback and manual drain
Feature flag exists to gate rollout per-customer and support canary enables
